name: suppress_automatic_battle_music_switching

stack.evidence: func_001E9C30 takes no Script context and calls func_0011E340 without accessing the value stack

notes: func_0011E340 sets suppression flag D_002BD8E0. While set, func_0011E360 observes battle-mode transitions but skips the automatic crossfade between field-music channel 0 and battle-music channel 1 performed by func_0011E2A8 and func_0011E2F8. The only JP call occurs in al02.ard at the Cave of Wonders tiger-head entrance, after fading in and immediately before an enemy-wave sequence that uses the normal Agrabah battle music. Command 720 clears the suppression.
